name: London 1889
designer: Unidentified in the consulted historical specimen
description: Ornamental capitals with swelling strokes, flared terminals and selectively descending stems.
observed: Directly traced characters: 5678ACDEFGHIKLMNOPRSTUVW. Printed page 179, PDF page 185. Larger impressions anchor the master; smaller sizes supply additional characters. Original crops are also retained for separately labelled reconstructions.
reconstructed: Inferred companion letters and figures: BJQXYZ012349. Punctuation and remaining symbols are new project drawings. Lowercase input aliases the capitals. Spacing and harmonisation of optical sizes are modern choices. The 1889 suffix dates the source, not a claim of first release.

sources.title: Specimen book from the Boston type foundry (1889), London; printed p. 179, one-based PDF page 185, Internet Archive leaf 185
sources.rights: 1889 US publication, public domain under the maximum historical 95-year term. Library of Congress scan hosted by Internet Archive; retained institutional metadata says the Library is unaware of copyright restrictions. Original native JP2 leaf; no modern digital typeface used.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: Reviewed transcriptions and exact native crops are retained in source/rows.json, selections.json and tracing.json. New companions are recorded separately with construction notes. Measured baselines include page slope. Optical-size differences and ornamental spurs are retained; small-source replacements are explicitly labelled.
